findings.location: HTML, paragraph beginning “Learn all that you can about being a woman of God”
findings.source_quote: Observe His heart in women who obey the Word with godly fear.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace «بخشية تقوية» with «بخشية الله» to convey “with godly fear.”
findings.translation_quote: وتأملن قلبه في النساء اللواتي يطعن الكلمة بخشية تقوية.
